bibliography.abstract: The use of e-commerce mobile applications is expanding in Nigeria, creating both opportunities and risks, including fraud and reduced user control over digital technologies, raising concerns about digital sovereignty. This research examines how Artificial Intelligence (AI) in Nigerian mobile applications affects digital sovereignty, examined through platform transparency as a key indicator of user awareness and control. Using an interpretive approach, the research combines the forensic analysis of selected Android applications with contextual document analysis to identify AI features and evaluate disclosure practices. The findings show that AI is widely implemented in the applications, yet transparency about its use remains limited. A socio-economic analysis of Nigeria further shows an increasing dependence on consumer digital platforms, moderate AI awareness, and uneven patterns of interaction. By providing empirical evidence on AI transparency and platform practices, this study advances understanding of individual digital sovereignty and highlights challenges for protecting user control in AI-driven digital environments.
bibliography.title: Investigating Artificial Intelligence Digital Sovereignty in Mobile Shopping Apps: A Case Study of Nigeria

en.caveats: The study relies on a qualitative, interpretive approach and forensic analysis of selected apps rather than a comprehensive, market-wide audit of all mobile shopping platforms.
en.what: This study analyzes the presence of AI features and the transparency of their disclosure in Nigerian Android mobile shopping applications using a forensic analysis of selected apps combined with contextual document analysis. The findings reveal widespread implementation of AI technologies across these e-commerce platforms, contrasted by very limited disclosure and transparency regarding how the AI is used.
en.why: It provides empirical evidence on how the lack of platform transparency in a rapidly growing e-commerce market undermines individual digital sovereignty, establishing a baseline of user awareness and control in a developing digital economy.
